description.zh: 翻译文本的格式，html（ 网页格式。设置此参数将对待翻译文本以及翻译后文本按照html格式进行处理）、text（文本格式。设置此参数将对传入待翻译文本以及翻译后结果不做文本格式处理，统一按纯文本格式处理。
description.en: Format of the text to be translated: html (webpage format; setting this parameter processes both the source and translated text as HTML) or text (plain text format; setting this parameter treats both the input source text and the translation result as plain text without any special formatting).
The default value for the General-purpose Edition is: general

title.en: Invoke General-purpose Edition of Machine Translation

descriptions.zh:
注意事项
1、QPS限制50，如有扩展需求，请与我们联系。钉钉群号：23369411
<props="intl">2、请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解通用版翻译产品的收费方式和价格</ph></props>
<props="china">2、字符长度上限是5000字符，若超出上限，可以保存成文件，使用[文档翻译](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/164151.html)</ph></props>

descriptions.en:
Notes  
1. The queries per second (QPS) limit is 50. If you need to increase this limit, please contact us. DingTalk group number: 23369411  
<props="intl">2. Ensure that you fully understand the billing method and pricing of the General-purpose Edition translation product before using this API.</ph></props>  
<props="china">2. The maximum character length is 5,000 characters. If your input exceeds this limit, save it as a file and use [Document Translation](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/164151.html).</ph></props>  
<props="china">3. Ensure that you fully understand the billing method and pricing of the General-purpose Edition translation product before using this API.</ph></props>
